'''2016 MPC Jeffrey Johns DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
